title: Clustering with potential multidimensionality: Inference and practice
title_zh: 多维潜聚类：推断与实践
title_primary: 多维潜聚类：推断与实践
title_secondary: Clustering with potential multidimensionality: Inference and practice
authors: Ruonan Xu, Luther Yap
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show how clustering standard errors in one or more dimensions can be justified in M-estimation when there is sampling or assignment uncertainty. Since existing procedures for variance estimation are either conservative or invalid, we propose a variance estimator that refines a conservative procedure and remains valid. We then interpret environments where clustering is frequently employed in empirical work from our design-based perspective and provide insights on their estimands and inference procedures.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了在M估计中，当存在抽样或分配不确定性时，如何在一个或多个维度上对标准误进行聚类是合理的。鉴于现有的方差估计程序要么保守要么无效，我们提出了一种方差估计器，它改进了保守程序并保持有效性。随后，我们从基于设计的视角解读了实证工作中频繁采用聚类的环境，并对其估计目标及推断程序提供了见解。

title: When Loss Strikes Twice: Severe Health Shocks and Financial Well-Being
title_zh: 当损失双重来袭：严重健康冲击与财务福祉
title_primary: 当损失双重来袭：严重健康冲击与财务福祉
title_secondary: When Loss Strikes Twice: Severe Health Shocks and Financial Well-Being
authors: Kaveh Majlesi, Elin Molin, Paula Roth
official: 官方在线 2026-02-14 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine the impact of fatal and nonfatal health shocks on household defaults on financial obligations. We show that fatal shocks significantly increase the likelihood of defaults and provide evidence that housing wealth serves as an important self-insurance mechanism. Surviving spouses experiencing the greatest income losses are more likely to liquidate their homes, and those lacking housing wealth face a heightened risk of debt collection. Notably, these shocks have intergenerational consequences. Nonfatal health shocks cause a smaller rise in default risk and housing wealth is less predictive of defaults. These findings suggest that improving survivors' benefits for those who lack resources could enhance welfare across generations.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了致命与非致命健康冲击对家庭金融债务违约的影响。结果显示，致命冲击显著提高了违约可能性，并提供了证据表明住房财富作为一种重要的自我保险机制。经历最大收入损失的丧偶配偶更可能出售房产，而那些缺乏住房财富的个体面临更高的债务追讨风险。值得注意的是，这些冲击具有跨代影响。非致命健康冲击导致的违约风险上升幅度较小，且住房财富对违约的预测作用较弱。这些发现表明，为缺乏资源的幸存者改善遗属福利，可能提升跨代福祉。

title: Disintermediation Governance and Complementor Innovation: An Empirical Look at Amazon.com
title_zh: 去中介化治理与互补者创新：基于亚马逊的实证研究
title_primary: 去中介化治理与互补者创新：基于亚马逊的实证研究
title_secondary: Disintermediation Governance and Complementor Innovation: An Empirical Look at Amazon.com
authors: Xia Han, Gaoyang Cai, Grace Gu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates how the platform’s disintermediation governance policy (i.e., the policy that disciplines complementors and consumers circumventing the platform to transact directly) affects complementors’ product innovation and launching strategies. We leverage a change in the Communication Guideline on Amazon.com (i.e., the focal platform), which prohibits complementors (i.e., sellers) from sending external website links, telephone numbers, and email addresses to buyers in direct messaging, as a policy shock to Amazon complementors. By conducting a difference-in-differences analysis, we find that the governance policy significantly reduces product innovation on the focal platform among complementors with direct selling channels as measured by the number of new products and the innovativeness of new products. These main effects are mitigated by complementor reputation on Amazon and complementor multihoming. Mechanism analyses show that complementors with direct selling channels increase the number of new products launched through those channels after the policy change (i.e., the switching effect). Moreover, complementors tend to strategically switch innovative and high-value products away from the focal platform while leaving less innovative but price-competitive products on it to attract Amazon consumers before diverting to their direct selling channels (i.e., the bait effect). Our results have implications for platform governance policies regarding disintermediation and its impact on complementor product innovation and launch strategies both on and off the focal platform. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Funding: G. Gu gratefully acknowledges research support from the USC Marshall School of Business. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04439 .
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了平台的去中介化治理政策（即对绕过平台直接交易的互补者与消费者进行约束的政策）如何影响互补者的产品创新及发布策略。我们利用亚马逊（即焦点平台）《沟通指南》的一次变更作为对亚马逊互补者的政策冲击，该指南禁止互补者（即卖家）在直接消息中向买家发送外部网站链接、电话号码和电子邮件地址。通过双重差分分析，我们发现，该治理政策显著降低了拥有直销渠道的互补者在焦点平台上的产品创新，具体表现为新产品数量及新产品创新性的下降。这些主效应受到互补者在亚马逊上的声誉及互补者多归属行为的缓解。机制分析表明，政策变更后，拥有直销渠道的互补者增加了通过这些渠道发布的新产品数量（即转移效应）。此外，互补者倾向于策略性地将创新性强、高价值的产品从焦点平台转移，而将创新性较低但具有价格竞争力的产品留在平台上，以吸引亚马逊消费者，随后将其引导至直销渠道（即诱饵效应）。我们的研究结果对平台关于去中介化的治理政策及其对互补者在焦点平台内外产品创新和发布策略的影响具有启示意义。本文已被信息系统领域编辑D. J. Wu接受。资助：G. Gu感谢南加州大学马歇尔商学院的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04439获取。

title: The skill premium across countries in the era of industrial robots and artificial intelligence
title_zh: 工业机器人与人工智能时代各国技能溢价研究
title_primary: 工业机器人与人工智能时代各国技能溢价研究
title_secondary: The skill premium across countries in the era of industrial robots and artificial intelligence
authors: Marcos J. Ribeiro, Klaus Prettner
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How do new technologies affect economic growth and the skill premium? To answer this question, we analyze the impacts of industrial robots and artificial intelligence (AI) across 52 countries using counterfactual simulations. In so doing, we simulate the nested CES production function framework of Bloom et al. (2025) with low-skilled workers, high-skilled workers, traditional capital, robots, and AI. Our contribution lies in documenting substantial heterogeneity across income groups: the inequality-increasing effect of robots and the inequality-reducing effect of AI are particularly strong in high-income countries, while they are less pronounced among upper-middle and lower-middle income countries. In addition, we show that both technologies boost economic growth. In terms of policy recommendations, our framework suggests i) balanced investment in both types of automation technologies to increase economic growth while keeping wage inequality subdued, and ii) investments in education and skill-upgrading to mitigate negative effects of robot use on wage inequality.
abstract_zh: 新技术如何影响经济增长与技能溢价？为解答此问题，我们运用反事实模拟方法，分析了52个国家中工业机器人与人工智能（AI）的影响。具体而言，我们模拟了Bloom等人（2025）提出的嵌套CES生产函数框架，该框架涵盖低技能工人、高技能工人、传统资本、机器人与AI。我们的贡献在于记录了不同收入群体间的显著异质性：机器人加剧不平等及AI缓解不平等的作用在高收入国家尤为突出，而在中高收入及中低收入国家则相对较弱。此外，我们表明这两种技术均能促进经济增长。就政策建议而言，我们的框架提出：i）对两类自动化技术进行均衡投资，以在促进经济增长的同时抑制工资不平等；ii）投资于教育与技能提升，以减轻机器人使用对工资不平等的负面影响。

title: Bias Correction in Factor-Augmented Regression Models with Weak Factors
title_zh: 弱因子情形下因子增强回归模型的偏差修正
title_primary: 弱因子情形下因子增强回归模型的偏差修正
title_secondary: Bias Correction in Factor-Augmented Regression Models with Weak Factors
authors: Peiyun Jiang, Yoshimasa Uematsu, Takashi Yamagata
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we study the asymptotic bias of the factor-augmented regression estimator and its reduction, which is augmented by the $r$ factors extracted from a large number of $N$ variables with $T$ observations. In particular, we consider general weak latent factor models with $r$ signal eigenvalues that may diverge at different rates, $N^{\alpha _{k}}$, $0<\alpha _{k}\leq 1$, $k=1,\dots,r$. In the existing literature, the bias has been derived using an approximation for the estimated factors with a specific data-dependent rotation matrix $\hat{H}$ for the model with $\alpha_{k}=1$ for all $k$, whereas we derive the bias for weak factor models. In addition, we derive the bias using the approximation with a different rotation matrix $\hat{H}_q$, which generally has a smaller bias than with $\hat{H}$. We also derive the bias using our preferred approximation with a purely signal-dependent rotation $H$, which is unique and can be regarded as the population version of $\hat{H}$ and $\hat{H}_q$. Since this bias is parametrically inestimable, we propose a split-panel jackknife bias correction, and theory shows that it successfully reduces the bias. The extensive finite-sample experiments suggest that the proposed bias correction works very well, and the empirical application illustrates its usefulness in practice.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了因子增强回归估计量的渐近偏差及其缩减方法，该估计量通过从包含T个观测值的N个变量中提取的r个因子进行增强。特别地，我们考虑了具有r个信号特征值的通用弱潜在因子模型，这些特征值可能以不同速率发散，即$N^{\alpha _{k}}$，其中$0<\alpha _{k}\leq 1$，$k=1,\dots,r$。在现有文献中，偏差是通过使用特定数据依赖的旋转矩阵$\hat{H}$对估计因子进行近似推导得出的，该模型假设所有$k$的$\alpha_{k}=1$，而我们则针对弱因子模型推导了偏差。此外，我们使用不同的旋转矩阵$\hat{H}_q$进行近似来推导偏差，该矩阵通常比$\hat{H}$产生的偏差更小。我们还使用我们偏好的近似方法，即纯信号依赖的旋转$H$来推导偏差，该旋转是唯一的，可视为$\hat{H}$和$\hat{H}_q$的总体版本。由于该偏差在参数上不可估计，我们提出了一种分割面板刀切法偏差校正方法，理论表明该方法能有效减少偏差。广泛的有限样本实验表明，所提出的偏差校正方法效果良好，实证应用也展示了其在实际中的有用性。

title: International Arbitrage Premia
title_zh: 国际套利溢价
title_primary: 国际套利溢价
title_secondary: International Arbitrage Premia
authors: Mirela Sandulescu, Paul Schneider
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We introduce the nonlinear arbitrage correction (NAC), the residual that renders a linear benchmark model arbitrage-free while preserving the law of one price. The price of NAC captures the marginal Sharpe ratio increase consistent with no-arbitrage and upper-bounds the constrained Hansen–Jagannathan distance. Using four decades of international equity, currency, and factor returns, NAC is strongly countercyclical, peaking during crises when linear models turn negative. The implied Sharpe ratio increase reaches 0.3, underscoring its economic relevance. While linear models perform well on average, they fail in distressed states, underpricing nonlinear payoffs. Incorporating NAC restores positivity and stabilizes pricing across regimes. (JEL G11, G12, G15)
abstract_zh: 我们引入了非线性套利修正（NAC），这是一种残差，使得线性基准模型在保持一价定律的同时实现无套利。NAC的价格捕捉了与无套利相一致的边际夏普比率提升，并限制了受约束的Hansen-Jagannathan距离。利用四十年间的国际股票、货币和因子回报数据，NAC表现出强烈的逆周期性，在线性模型转为负值的危机期间达到峰值。隐含的夏普比率提升达到0.3，凸显了其经济重要性。尽管线性模型在平均情况下表现良好，但在困境状态下它们失效，低估了非线性收益。纳入NAC可恢复正性并稳定跨体制的定价。（JEL G11, G12, G15）

title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
title_zh: 关税传导至消费者价格的结构解析
title_primary: 关税传导至消费者价格的结构解析
title_secondary: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
authors: Mary Amiti, Sebastian Heise, David Weinstein
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Tariffs raise the prices of goods made at home, not just the imports they tax—an effect that standard pass-through estimates largely miss. Studying the 2025 U.S. tariffs, we find that about 26 percent of the tariff increase passes through to consumer prices. These estimates are measured relative to less-exposed goods and hold aggregate conditions fixed. The direct effect accounts for 64 percent of this increase, as tariffs raise the consumer prices of foreign varieties of a good. The remaining 36 percent arises indirectly—tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs used by U.S. producers, and domestic producers raise their markups because they face less competition from higher-priced imports. The direct effect passes through quickly, since tariffs raise import prices almost immediately, but the indirect effect takes nine to twelve months to work its way through supply chains. As a result, tariffs have a larger and more drawn-out impact on consumers than the direct effect alone would suggest.
abstract_zh: 关税不仅提高了其所征税的进口商品的价格，也抬高了国内生产的商品价格——这一效应在标准的汇率传导估算中大多被忽视。通过研究2025年美国关税，我们发现约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格。这些估算相对于受关税影响较小的商品进行衡量，并保持总体经济条件不变。直接效应占这一增幅的64%，因为关税提高了某商品外国品种的消费者价格。其余36%则间接产生——关税提高了美国生产商使用的进口投入品成本，而国内生产商因面临来自高价进口商品的竞争减少而提高其加成率。直接效应传导迅速，因为关税几乎立即推高了进口价格，但间接效应需要九到十二个月才能通过供应链逐步显现。因此，关税对消费者的影响比仅考虑直接效应所暗示的更为显著且持续时间更长。

title: Monetary Policy under Multiple Financing Constraints
title_zh: 多重融资约束下的货币政策
title_primary: 多重融资约束下的货币政策
title_secondary: Monetary Policy under Multiple Financing Constraints
authors: Ander Perez-Orive, Yannick Timmer, Alejandro van der Ghote
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We revisit the credit channel of monetary policy when firms face multiple financing constraints. Our theory shows that the multiplicity of constraints dampens the transmission of expansionary policy to firm borrowing and investment notably but amplifies the transmission of policy tightening. This asymmetry arises because, when policy tightens (eases), the most (least) responsive constraint binds. Using U.S. firm-level data and exploiting a quasi-natural experiment, we find strong support for these predictions. Embedding the mechanism into a New Keynesian framework, we find that the drop in investment after contractionary shocks is twice as large as its increase following equally-sized expansionary shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了当企业面临多重融资约束时货币政策的信贷渠道。我们的理论表明，约束的多重性显著削弱了扩张性政策向企业借贷和投资的传导，但放大了政策收紧的传导效应。这种不对称性源于，当政策收紧（放松）时，最（不）敏感的约束起主导作用。利用美国企业层面数据并借助准自然实验，我们为这些预测找到了有力支持。将该机制嵌入新凯恩斯框架后，我们发现，紧缩性冲击后投资的下降幅度是同等规模扩张性冲击后投资上升幅度的两倍。

title: How the U.S. entity list affects firm breakthrough innovation: A perspective on knowledge depth and breadth
title_zh: 美国实体清单如何影响企业突破性创新：基于知识深度与广度的视角
title_primary: 美国实体清单如何影响企业突破性创新：基于知识深度与广度的视角
title_secondary: How the U.S. entity list affects firm breakthrough innovation: A perspective on knowledge depth and breadth
authors: Dandan Li, Yiling Zhang, Yuhua Li
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Based on knowledge combination theory, we explore the effect of the U.S. Entity List on firm breakthrough innovation, using a research sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2013 to 2022. Our findings reveal that the U.S. Entity List significantly inhibits these firms' breakthrough innovation. The U.S. Entity List lowers knowledge breadth while enhancing knowledge depth. However, as the impact of knowledge breadth on breakthrough innovation outweighs that of knowledge depth, the U.S. Entity List ultimately inhibits firm breakthrough innovation. Government innovation subsidies and supply chain integration capabilities of firms mitigate the negative effect of the U.S. Entity List on breakthrough innovation. Additionally, we find that the negative effect of the U.S. Entity List on breakthrough innovation is stronger in technology-intensive, regulated, and competitive industries.
abstract_zh: 基于知识组合理论，本文以2013至2022年中国A股上市公司为研究样本，探讨了美国实体清单对企业突破性创新的影响。研究发现，美国实体清单显著抑制了这些企业的突破性创新。该清单降低了知识广度，同时提升了知识深度。然而，由于知识广度对突破性创新的影响大于知识深度，美国实体清单最终抑制了企业的突破性创新。政府创新补贴及企业的供应链整合能力缓解了美国实体清单对突破性创新的负面效应。此外，本文还发现，在技术密集型、受监管及竞争激烈的行业中，美国实体清单对突破性创新的负面效应更为显著。

title: Cultural Momentum, Demographic Divergence, and Population Prospects in India, 2100: Son Preference as a Structural Driver of Fertility and Long-Term Projections
title_zh: 文化惯性、人口分化与印度2100年人口前景：子嗣偏好作为生育率的结构性驱动因素及长期预测
title_primary: 文化惯性、人口分化与印度2100年人口前景：子嗣偏好作为生育率的结构性驱动因素及长期预测
title_secondary: Cultural Momentum, Demographic Divergence, and Population Prospects in India, 2100: Son Preference as a Structural Driver of Fertility and Long-Term Projections
authors: Yadav, Harsh, Goli, Srinivas
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Standard cohort-component projection models for India omit one of the most durable behavioural drivers of fertility: son preference operating through Differential Stopping Behaviour (DSB). This paper addresses that gap by introducing son preference as an explicit stratification dimension alongside education and urban-rural residence extending the Vienna School’s multi-dimensional demographic framework to include gender norms as a structural modifier of fertility. Using a relational Gompertz framework estimated from a 300-cell state-by-residence-by-son-preference-category-by-NFHS-round panel, we find that son preference raises TFR by 15.4 per cent net of all socioeconomic controls and shifts the fertility schedule toward older ages. A 10 per cent permanent reduction in DSB-driven fertility from 2021 yields approximately 50–60 million fewer people across 15 major states by 2100; an SSP2-style counterfactual places the full demographic cost at 426 million. Shift-share decomposition reveals that in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, cultural momentum defined as cumulative population divergence from the sustained gap between observed and structurally expected fertility operates alongside demographic momentum as a binding constraint. These results suggest that projection models conditioned only on development covariates may understate long-run population size in high-preference states.
abstract_zh: 印度标准队列要素预测模型忽略了生育率最持久的行为驱动因素之一：通过差异化停止行为（DSB）运作的男孩偏好。本文通过将男孩偏好作为与教育和城乡居住并列的明确分层维度，扩展了维也纳学派的多维人口学框架，将性别规范作为生育率的结构性调节因素，从而填补了这一空白。利用基于300个单元（按邦、居住地、男孩偏好类别和NFHS轮次划分的面板数据）估计的关系型Gompertz模型，我们发现，在控制所有社会经济变量后，男孩偏好使总和生育率（TFR）净提高15.4%，并将生育时间表向较高年龄推移。从2021年起，DSB驱动的生育率永久性降低10%，将使15个主要邦到2100年的人口减少约5000万至6000万；而SSP2式的反事实情景则显示，全部人口成本高达4.26亿。份额转移分解表明，在北方邦和北方邦，文化动量（定义为观察到的生育率与结构性预期生育率之间持续差距所累积的人口分化）与人口动量共同构成刚性约束。这些结果表明，仅以发展协变量为条件的预测模型可能低估高偏好邦的长期人口规模。

title: Learning and the Efficiency of Expert Referrals
title_zh: 专家推荐的学习与效率
title_primary: 专家推荐的学习与效率
title_secondary: Learning and the Efficiency of Expert Referrals
authors: Ian McCarthy, Seth Richards-Shubik
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Buyers of complex goods and services often rely on the advice of expert intermediaries who are themselves imperfectly informed about the quality of the available options. How well do these intermediaries learn about that quality and act on it? We study this question in the setting of referrals from primary care physicians (PCPs) to specialists, using data on 4.5 million joint replacement surgeries for Medicare beneficiaries. We first document substantial heterogeneity in specialist quality and costs within geographic markets, and we present design-based evidence showing that PCPs adjust their referrals specifically based on the outcomes of their own patients. We then employ a structural learning model of PCP referral choices to quantify the losses from informational frictions and to simulate possible reallocations with improved information. Beyond learning, the model also accounts for limitations on possible reallocations due to habit persistence and capacity constraints. We find that about one-quarter of patients would be referred to a different specialist in the absence of informational frictions, with small but meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
abstract_zh: 复杂商品和服务的购买者通常依赖专家中介的建议，而这些中介自身对可选方案的质量信息掌握并不完全。这些中介如何学习质量信息并据此采取行动？我们以初级保健医生（PCP）向专科医生的转诊为研究场景，利用450万例联邦医疗保险受益人的关节置换手术数据展开分析。首先，我们证实地理市场内专科医生质量和成本存在显著异质性，并通过基于设计的方法证明初级保健医生会依据自身患者的治疗结果调整转诊决策。随后，我们构建初级保健医生转诊选择的结构性学习模型，量化信息摩擦造成的损失，并模拟信息改善后的潜在资源再分配。除学习机制外，该模型还考虑了习惯持续性和产能约束对资源再分配的限制。研究发现，若无信息摩擦，约四分之一的患者将被转诊至不同专科医生，患者预后将获得微小但显著的改善。

title: Harmonising access and reinventing the procurement of innovative medicines in Europe
title_zh: 协调获取与重塑欧洲创新药物采购
title_primary: 协调获取与重塑欧洲创新药物采购
title_secondary: Harmonising access and reinventing the procurement of innovative medicines in Europe
authors: Pierre Dubois
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Europe pays for innovative medicines through 27 uncoordinated national negotiations, generating access delays, cross-country pricing externalities, and a weak position vis-à-vis both pharmaceutical firms and US trade and most-favoured nation pressure. This column argues that Europe should procure innovative on-patent medicines through a single European negotiation that fixes one wholesale price for the entire Single Market, while reintroducing equity across member states through differentiated national contributions and side transfers. Decoupling what the innovator receives from what each country pays would end the pathologies of external reference pricing and parallel trade, restore Europe's bargaining power, and guarantee simultaneous access for all European patients.
abstract_zh: 欧洲通过27个缺乏协调的国家谈判为创新药物买单，导致患者获取药物延迟、跨境定价外部性，以及面对制药公司、美国贸易与最惠国待遇压力时处于弱势地位。本文认为，欧洲应通过单一欧洲谈判采购创新专利药物，为整个单一市场设定统一的批发价格，同时通过差异化的国家缴费和横向转移支付重新实现成员国间的公平。将创新者获得的报酬与各国实际支付金额脱钩，将终结外部参考定价和平行贸易的弊端，恢复欧洲的议价能力，并确保所有欧洲患者能够同步获得药物。

title: The virtues of lab experiments
title_zh: 实验室实验的优点
title_primary: 实验室实验的优点
title_secondary: The virtues of lab experiments
authors: Gary Charness, James C. Cox, Catherine C. Eckel, Charles A. Holt, Brian Jabarian
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Physical laboratory experiments occupy a key position within experimental economics for a wide range of research questions, offering crucial methodological rigor by ensuring human authenticity, controlling informational conditions, directing interpersonal interactions, ensuring protocol credibility, and reliably administering monetary incentives. These factors contribute to the empirical robustness of experimental findings. The continued advancement of online experimental platforms offers complementary scientific benefits to laboratory experiments, such as lowering costs and increasing sample diversity. We identify and elaborate on specific research questions for which laboratory-based methods offer clear scientific advantages, emphasizing their ability to yield precise, insightful, and replicable data.
abstract_zh: 物理实验室实验在实验经济学中占据关键地位，适用于广泛的研究问题，通过确保人类真实性、控制信息条件、引导人际互动、保证协议可信度以及可靠实施货币激励，提供了至关重要的方法论严谨性。这些因素有助于增强实验发现的经验稳健性。在线实验平台的持续进步为实验室实验提供了互补的科学优势，例如降低成本和提高样本多样性。我们识别并详细阐述了实验室方法具有明显科学优势的具体研究问题，强调其在生成精确、深刻且可复制数据方面的能力。

title: Is Agricultural Insurance a Panacea for a Better Environment? Fertilizer Usage by Chinese Farmers
title_zh: 农业保险是改善环境的灵丹妙药吗？中国农户的化肥使用行为
title_primary: 农业保险是改善环境的灵丹妙药吗？中国农户的化肥使用行为
title_secondary: Is Agricultural Insurance a Panacea for a Better Environment? Fertilizer Usage by Chinese Farmers
authors: Zou, Baoling, Qiu, Xiuhong, Mishra, Ashok K.
source: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Agricultural insurance serves as a crucial tool for risk management, helping to lessen the impact of natural disasters on farming and ensuring rural economic stability. This study analyzes survey data from the 2020-2021 China Land Economic Survey. We employ a Propensity Score Matching-Difference-in-Differences (PSM-DID) method to assess the effect of agricultural insurance on farmers’ fertilizer use. Results indicate that insured farmers tend to spend more on chemical fertilizers. These findings remain consistent across various models and outcome measures. Additional analysis suggests that this effect primarily arises from changes in crop selection and farmers’ risk tolerance. Policymakers could consider designing insurance policies that link fertilizer application levels to subsidies, expanding education and agricultural training, and encouraging practices such as crop rotation.

title: Deagrarianization and socioeconomic drivers of forest cover change in rural Poland
title_zh: 波兰农村地区去农业化与森林覆盖变化的社会经济驱动因素
title_primary: 波兰农村地区去农业化与森林覆盖变化的社会经济驱动因素
title_secondary: Deagrarianization and socioeconomic drivers of forest cover change in rural Poland
authors: Sławomir Sioma, Monika Stanny, Łukasz Komorowski, Jarosław Socha
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how changes in forest cover in rural Poland are related to socioeconomic development and the degree of deagrarianization of local economies. Understanding these relationships is essential for the design of effective land-use and afforestation policies in structurally diverse rural regions. The analysis was conducted at the level of local administrative units (LAU), covering all rural municipalities in Poland during 2004–2013, a period of intensive forest expansion supported by the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). During the study period, Poland’s forest area increased from 28.7% to 29.3%. Private forests accounted for 80.5% of this increase, indicating that agricultural land-to-forest transitions were the dominant source of new forest area. Using generalized additive models, we identified distinct non-linear relationships between afforestation intensity and key socioeconomic indicators. Forest cover growth was strongest in municipalities with low levels of socioeconomic development and a dominant agricultural function. The effect of deagrarianization was threshold-based: afforestation intensity increased with the deagrarianization index up to approximately 0.3, beyond which no further increase was observed. Spatially, forest expansion was concentrated in peripheral municipalities, particularly those distant from regional centres and characterised by relative monofunc
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了波兰农村森林覆盖变化与当地社会经济发展及经济去农业化程度之间的关系。理解这些关系对于在结构多样化的农村地区制定有效的土地利用和造林政策至关重要。分析在地方行政单位（LAU）层面进行，覆盖了2004—2013年间波兰所有农村市镇，这一时期在共同农业政策（CAP）支持下森林面积快速扩张。研究期间，波兰森林面积从28.7%增加到29.3%。私有林占这一增量的80.5%，表明农地转林地是新增森林面积的主要来源。利用广义加性模型，我们识别出造林强度与关键社会经济指标之间显著的非线性关系。森林覆盖增长在社会经济发展水平较低且以农业功能为主的市镇中最为强劲。去农业化的影响具有阈值效应：造林强度随去农业化指数上升而增加，直至约0.3，此后不再进一步增加。在空间上，森林扩张集中于边缘市镇，尤其是那些远离区域中心且以相对单一功能为特征的地区。

title: Disconnected: The unequal impact of online learning on minority students
title_zh: 脱节：在线学习对少数族裔学生的不平等影响
title_primary: 脱节：在线学习对少数族裔学生的不平等影响
title_secondary: Disconnected: The unequal impact of online learning on minority students
authors: Naomi Gershoni, Miri Stryjan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Online instruction holds the promise of expanding access to education for disadvantaged groups, yet it often deepens existing performance gaps. This study examines its impact on high-stakes exam outcomes, focusing on mechanisms driving differential effects for minority students. We leverage rich administrative data on students from five consecutive cohorts in 31 Israeli vocational colleges and the abrupt transition to online instruction during the COVID-19 pandemic. A key advantage of our setting is that exams were held in-person and graded centrally, ensuring comparability to pre-pandemic performance. Using a difference-in-differences design that compares outcomes within students and across cohorts, we find significant declines in both exam attendance and demonstrated knowledge following the switch to online instruction. These effects are not explained by local infection rates or childcare responsibilities, and are especially pronounced among Arabic-speaking minority students, regardless of their socioeconomic status. Drawing on variation in internet infrastructure, residential crowdedness, language of instruction, and prior academic performance, we show that poor internet access is a central mechanism underlying the adverse effects among minority students. For majority-group students, negative effects are concentrated among weaker students, suggesting widening disparities within the majority group. For minority students, the difference by prior achievement is not statistically significant, and if anything, the drop is larger for higher achievers.
abstract_zh: 在线教学有望扩大弱势群体接受教育的机会，然而它往往加剧了现有的成绩差距。本研究考察了在线教学对高风险考试结果的影响，重点关注驱动少数族裔学生差异化效应的机制。我们利用了来自以色列31所职业学院连续五届学生的大量行政数据，以及COVID-19疫情期间向在线教学的突然转变。我们研究设置的一个关键优势在于，考试以线下形式进行并由中央统一评分，确保了与疫情前成绩的可比性。采用双重差分设计，比较学生内部及不同队列之间的结果，我们发现转向在线教学后，考试出勤率和所展示的知识水平均显著下降。这些效应无法由当地感染率或育儿责任解释，并且在阿拉伯语少数族裔学生中尤为突出，无论其社会经济地位如何。利用互联网基础设施、居住拥挤程度、教学语言及先前学业成绩的差异，我们表明互联网接入不畅是少数族裔学生遭受不利影响的核心机制。对于多数群体学生，负面效应集中在学业较弱的学生中，表明多数群体内部差距在扩大。对于少数族裔学生，按先前学业成绩划分的差异在统计上不显著，甚至可以说，高成就者的下降幅度更大。

title: Spatiotemporal evolution and non-stationary drivers of banking financial institutions: evidence from financial license information in China
title_zh: 中国银行业金融机构时空演化及其非平稳驱动因素——基于金融许可证信息的证据
title_primary: 中国银行业金融机构时空演化及其非平稳驱动因素——基于金融许可证信息的证据
title_secondary: Spatiotemporal evolution and non-stationary drivers of banking financial institutions: evidence from financial license information in China
authors: Dameng Hu, Chong Li, Guoqiong Long
official: 官方在线 2025-09-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Based on financial licence information, this study identifies the entry and exit data of banking financial institutions (BFI) in China from 2005 to 2019. Using methods such as standard deviation ellipse, multi-distance spatial clustering, and kernel density estimation, we characterize the spatiotemporal patterns of various types of BFI. Furthermore, the optimal parameters geographic detector (OPGD) model and geographically and temporally weighted regression (GTWR) model are employed to uncover the key driving factors and their spatiotemporal non-stationarity. The results indicate that the scale of BFI has grown steadily, with expansion rates showing a ‘stepwise decline’ due to the influence of financial environments and national policies. Spatially, the distribution aligns along a ‘northeast-southwest’ axis, with a notable westward expansion trend. The spatial clustering patterns vary by institution type: non-deposit banking institutions exhibit weaker clustering, while city commercial banks show increasing clustering scale and intensity, and policy banks maintain stable clustering characteristics. Key drivers of BFI distribution include regional innovation and entrepreneurship levels, market size, and political attributes, with significant interactive effects, primarily characterized by two-factor enhancement. The main driving factors demonstrate non-stationarity across time and space, with varying directions and intensities of influence.

title: Can governance moderate FDI inflows to convert the pollution haven to a halo? Revisiting the BRICS context using the panel ARDL approach
title_zh: 治理能否调节外国直接投资流入，将污染天堂转变为光环？基于面板ARDL方法重新审视金砖国家情境
title_primary: 治理能否调节外国直接投资流入，将污染天堂转变为光环？基于面板ARDL方法重新审视金砖国家情境
title_secondary: Can governance moderate FDI inflows to convert the pollution haven to a halo? Revisiting the BRICS context using the panel ARDL approach
authors: Rimpa Chanda, Chandralekha Ghosh, Rupamanjari Sinha Ray
official: 官方在线 2025-09-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The article explores a tripartite framework comprising the Environmental Kuznets Curve, the pollution haven or halo hypotheses, and the Porter hypothesis with a specific focus on governance within the context of five BRICS nations. The study utilizes a panel ARDL model, which analyzes a dataset from 2000 to 2019 and incorporates a composite governance index derived from the Worldwide Governance Indicators. Results confirm the presence of an inverted U-shaped Environmental Kuznets Curve in the long run. Furthermore, trade openness is reported to increase carbon emissions in the long run, supporting the pollution haven hypothesis, while foreign direct investment exerts a statistically significant negative long-run effect on emissions, corroborating the pollution halo hypothesis. Distinctively, the study underscores how effective governance may moderate the relationship between FDI and carbon dioxide emissions, particularly through promoting renewable energy consumption. The article also reports pertinent governance-centric policy implications for emission reduction in BRICS countries.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一个包含环境库兹涅茨曲线、污染避难所或光环假说以及波特假说的三方框架，特别关注金砖五国背景下的治理问题。研究采用面板ARDL模型，分析了2000年至2019年的数据集，并纳入了基于全球治理指标构建的综合治理指数。结果证实了长期内存在倒U型环境库兹涅茨曲线。此外，贸易开放度在长期内增加了碳排放，支持了污染避难所假说，而外国直接投资对排放产生了统计上显著的负向长期效应，证实了污染光环假说。尤为独特的是，研究强调了有效治理如何可能调节外国直接投资与二氧化碳排放之间的关系，特别是通过促进可再生能源消费。文章还报告了针对金砖国家减排的以治理为核心的相关政策启示。

title: Bank concentration and SME borrower discouragement: the moderating influence of banking system stability
title_zh: 银行集中度与中小企业借款人受挫：银行体系稳定性的调节作用
title_primary: 银行集中度与中小企业借款人受挫：银行体系稳定性的调节作用
title_secondary: Bank concentration and SME borrower discouragement: the moderating influence of banking system stability
authors: Ginés Hernández-Cánovas Ana Mol-Gómez-Vázquez Pedro Martínez-Solano a Department of Economics, Accounting and Finance, Faculty of Business Administration, Universidad Politécnica de Cartagena, Cartagena, Spainb Department of Financial Economics and Accounting 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study uses a multilevel analysis to examine how banking system stability influences the relationship between bank concentration and borrower discouragement. The analysis uses 26 rounds of the Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises for 11 Eurozone countries between 2010 and 2022. We find that banking system stability reduces or even reverses the negative effect of bank concentration on borrower discouragement for small and medium-sized enterprises. Specifically, increased bank concentration reduces borrower discouragement when banking system stability, measured using the Z-score, is above certain thresholds: 20.6 for term loans and 21.97 for credit lines. These thresholds correspond to the 90th–95th percentiles of banking system stability in the data, meaning that only about 5–10% of firms operate in banking systems sufficiently stable for concentration to reduce discouragement. Micro firms benefit the most from bank concentration in stable banking systems but suffer the most in unstable ones. Additionally, increased bank concentration discourages credit line borrowers more than term loan borrowers in unstable systems, with the opposite effect in stable systems. Overall, maintaining banking system stability is essential for realizing the potential benefits of bank concentration, especially for small firms.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用多层次分析，探讨银行体系稳定性如何影响银行集中度与借款者受挫感之间的关系。分析基于2010年至2022年间欧元区11国企业融资调查的26轮数据。研究发现，银行体系稳定性能够削弱甚至逆转银行集中度对中小企业借款者受挫感的负面效应。具体而言，当以Z-score衡量的银行体系稳定性超过特定阈值时（定期贷款为20.6，信用额度为21.97），银行集中度的提高会降低借款者受挫感。这些阈值对应数据中银行体系稳定性的第90至第95百分位，意味着仅有约5%至10%的企业处于稳定性足以使集中度缓解受挫感的银行体系中。微型企业在稳定银行体系中从集中度获益最大，但在不稳定体系中受损也最严重。此外，在不稳定体系中，银行集中度提高对信用额度借款者的抑制作用强于定期贷款借款者，而在稳定体系中则呈现相反效应。总体而言，维持银行体系稳定性对于实现银行集中度的潜在效益至关重要，尤其对小型企业而言。

title: The impact of intelligent manufacturing on industrial pollution: firm-level evidence from China
title_zh: 智能制造对工业污染的影响：来自中国企业的微观证据
title_primary: 智能制造对工业污染的影响：来自中国企业的微观证据
title_secondary: The impact of intelligent manufacturing on industrial pollution: firm-level evidence from China
authors: Wen Wang Yingxue Sun Zhichen Huang a School of Economics and Finance, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Shaanxi, Xi’an, Chinab School of Economics, Fudan University, Shanghai, China
official: 官方在线 2025-06-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the effects of intelligent manufacturing on pollution emissions in China’s manufacturing sector. Using firm-level tax administrative survey data and a staggered difference-in-differences design, we exploit the spatial and temporal variation in robot park establishment as a quasi-natural experiment. We show that intelligent manufacturing contributes to the pollution emissions reduction. This effect operates through two primary mechanisms: technological progress effect, which improves total factor and labour productivity, and capital savings effect, which optimize energy consumption and reduce the intensity of fixed capital. Furthermore, the emission-reducing effects are more pronounced for large-scale, high-tech, and strategically emerging firms, with these effects further magnified in regions characterized by concentrated industrial clusters. These results provide critical insights into the complex trade-offs between achieving environmental objectives and maintaining industrial competitiveness in developing economies. KEYWORDS: Environmental regulation intelligent manufacturing developing economies place-based policy JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q53 O14 O33 Acknowledgements The authors would like to thank the Editor and two anonymous referees for valuable comments. All errors are our own.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了智能制造对中国制造业污染排放的影响。利用企业层面税收行政调查数据，并采用交错双重差分设计，我们将机器人产业园设立的空间与时间变化作为准自然实验。研究表明，智能制造有助于减少污染排放。这一效应通过两种主要机制实现：技术进步效应（提升全要素生产率与劳动生产率）与资本节约效应（优化能源消耗并降低固定资本强度）。此外，减排效应在大规模、高技术及战略性新兴企业中更为显著，且在产业集群集中的地区进一步放大。这些结论为理解发展中国家在实现环境目标与维持产业竞争力之间的复杂权衡提供了关键启示。关键词：环境规制 智能制造 发展中国家 地方性政策 JEL分类：Q53 O14 O33 致谢：作者感谢编辑及两位匿名审稿人的宝贵意见。文责自负。

title: Unconventional Fiscal Policy in Times of High Inflation
title_zh: 高通胀时期的非常规财政政策
title_primary: 高通胀时期的非常规财政政策
title_secondary: Unconventional Fiscal Policy in Times of High Inflation
authors: Mai Chi Dao, Allan Gloe Dizioli, Chris Jackson, Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas, Daniel Leigh
official: 官方在线 2023-09-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The surge in energy prices in 2022 has been a defining factor behind the increase in euro area inflation. We assess the impact of “unconventional fiscal policy,” defined as the set of fiscal measures, possibly expansionary, motivated by a desire to mute the effects of the increase in energy prices and to lower inflation. Overall, we find that these unconventional measures reduced euro area inflation by 1 to 2 percentage points in 2022 and may avoid an undershoot later on. When nonlinearities in the Phillips curve are taken into account, the net effect is to reduce inflation by about 0.5 percentage points in 2021-24, and keep it nearer to its target. About one-third to one-half of the reduction in 2022 reflects the direct effects of the measures on headline inflation, with much of the remainder reflecting the lower pass-through to core inflation. The fiscal measures were deficit-financed but had limited effects on raising inflation by stimulating demand and instead modestly helped to stabilize longer-term inflation expectations. Looking ahead, the prospective decline in inflation in the euro area is partly due to fortunate circumstances, with energy prices falling from their 2022 peaks and their pass-through effects fading, and with less economic overheating than in economies such as the United States. Implementing similar measures in the face of a more persistent increase in energy prices, or in a more overheated economy, would have caused a more persistent rise in core inflation.
abstract_zh: 2022年能源价格飙升是欧元区通胀上升的关键因素。我们评估了"非常规财政政策"的影响——这类政策指旨在缓解能源价格上涨冲击并降低通胀的财政措施（可能具有扩张性）。总体而言，我们发现这些非常规措施在2022年使欧元区通胀降低了1至2个百分点，并可能避免后续通胀过度回落。若考虑菲利普斯曲线的非线性特征，这些措施在2021-2024年间的净效应是将通胀降低约0.5个百分点，使其更接近目标水平。2022年通胀降幅中约三分之一至二分之一来自措施对整体通胀的直接影响，其余大部分则源于对核心通胀传导效应的减弱。这些财政措施虽通过赤字融资，但通过刺激需求推高通胀的效应有限，反而适度有助于稳定长期通胀预期。展望未来，欧元区通胀预期下降部分源于有利条件：能源价格从2022年峰值回落且传导效应减弱，同时经济过热程度低于美国等经济体。若在能源价格更持续上涨或经济更过热的情况下实施类似措施，将导致核心通胀更持久地上升。
